description: This file defines a custom cursor binder named ContactPhotoBinder for an Android application. It binds contact photos to views by querying contact images from the contacts provider, caching them, and setting them as compound drawables on TextViews.

classes.name: ContactPhotoBinder
classes.description: A custom cursor binder that loads contact photos from the contacts provider, caches them, and sets them as drawable icons in TextViews.

methods.name: ContactPhotoBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resources, default drawable, cache, and photo size based on display metrics.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a contact photo to a TextView by querying the contact's ID from the cursor, loading the photo, caching it, and setting it as a compound drawable.
